summary: Russian forces launched extensive missile and drone attacks across Ukraine on July 30-31, 2026, targeting infrastructure in multiple regions including Vinnytsia, Sumy, and Khmelnytskyi. Ukraine's Defense Intelligence reports Russian advances near Kalenykiv and ongoing threats to critical infrastructure. The conflict continues with significant strikes on ports, industrial facilities, and civilian areas.
key_points: Russian forces launched 74 missiles and 284 drones in overnight attacks across Ukraine on July 30-31, 2026. (Source: UkraineNow/83042)
Ukraine's Defense Intelligence reports Russian forces advancing near Kalenykiv in Kharkiv region. (Source: DeepStateUA/23698)
Russian strikes hit industrial infrastructure in Sumy region, setting fire to a major postal terminal in Dnipro. (Source: UkraineNow/83033)
Multiple drone groups from the Black Sea targeted Odesa region with several groups approaching the city. (Source: kpszsu/70919, kpszsu/70924)
Explosions and secondary detonations occurred at a military unit in Khmelnytskyi region, with casualty details still being clarified. (Source: UkraineNow/83061)
A powerful explosion with secondary detonation occurred in Khmelnitskyi region, with cause and damage details not yet reported. (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/32073)
Russian forces destroyed over 200 gas stations across Ukraine, with at least 80 located in the Kharkiv region. (Source: ukr_leaks_eng/32066)
A Russian North Korean-made ballistic missile struck the village of Radushne in Dnipropetrovsk region, killing a family of seven. (Source: UkraineNow/83035)

points: On July 30-31, 2026, Russian forces launched 74 missiles and 284 drones across Ukraine, with 93% of verified shelters reportedly having problems according to Reuters. (Source: UkraineNow/83042)

A Russian North Korean-made ballistic missile struck the village of Radushne in Dnipropetrovsk region on July 31, 2026, killing seven family members - parents Olena and Artem Voronov, and children Mark, Azarii Ilyay, and Emilia, with five other family members still missing. (Source: UkraineNow/83035)

Russian strikes hit industrial infrastructure in Sumy region on July 31, 2026, setting fire to an automated sorting terminal of 'Nova Poshta' in Dnipro, where workers successfully evacuated. (Source: UkraineNow/83033)

Ukrainian forces reportedly attempted to evacuate from Konstantinivka under the guise of civilians and conducted sabotage attempts, according to Russian Defense Ministry video. (Source: tass_agency/388053)

Ukrainian forces struck an aircraft plant in Evpatoria, hitting two hangars for aircraft storage and a production workshop at the Evpatoria Aviation Plant, as well as infrastructure at the Taman port and the 'Lukoil-Volgogradneftepererabotka' oil processing plant, one of the largest in Russia. (Source: UkraineNow/83049)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces have escalated their campaign against Ukrainian infrastructure with coordinated missile and drone strikes across multiple regions, demonstrating increased operational tempo and targeting civilian facilities. The use of North Korean-made ballistic missiles represents a significant escalation in weapon systems, with the Radushne attack killing seven family members. Ukrainian forces face pressure on multiple fronts, with reported advances near Kalenykiv and ongoing threats to critical infrastructure including ports, industrial facilities, and energy infrastructure. The conflict shows signs of intensifying with Russia expanding its arsenal and targeting deeper into Ukrainian territory.
sections.regional_response: Poland confirmed that a Russian winged Kh-101 missile reached its territory on July 31, 2026, raising concerns about NATO's Article 5 obligations. Bulgaria took control of two Lukoil companies deemed national security risks to prevent Russian ownership. Finland's Interior Minister suggested suspending the Schengen agreement with Spain due to migration issues in Seute. These regional responses indicate growing concern among neighboring countries about Russian escalation and its spillover effects beyond Ukraine's borders.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian forces demonstrate sophisticated coordination in their missile and drone campaigns, with multiple simultaneous attacks across Ukraine's territory. The targeting of civilian infrastructure, including gas stations, postal facilities, and residential areas, suggests a strategy of economic warfare and civilian attrition. Ukrainian Defense Intelligence's updated maps show Russian advances near Kalenykiv, indicating potential breakthroughs in the eastern sector. The use of North Korean weapons systems represents a concerning expansion of Russia's international support network and weapon capabilities.
